description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R} and choosing to pay {2}{R}{R} and reveal Through the Breach from your hand, adding Through the Breach's effects to Desperate Ritual.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Desperate Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R} and putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
